name: LGM-30G Minuteman III
note: USAF LGM-30G Minuteman III silo-based intercontinental ballistic missile (W87 or W78 warhead), one missile per hardened silo. Range commonly cited ~13,000 km; some sources give ~10,000 km.

source.title: LGM-30 Minuteman | Wikipedia
source.note: Minuteman III is a full-range ICBM; commonly cited ~13,000 km. The page notes an early-variant 'operational range of 5,500 nmi (10,200 km)', so sources span ~10,000-13,000 km.

name: RS-24 Yars
note: Russian RS-24 Yars intercontinental ballistic missile (SS-27 Mod 2 / SS-29), MIRV with up to ~4 warheads, deployed in both road-mobile and silo variants. A 2007 test flew ~5,750 km to the Kura range; the full ICBM range is commonly cited ~11,000-12,000 km.

source.title: RS-24 Yars | Wikipedia
source.note: MIRV-equipped ICBM; a 2007 test 'landed on target about 5,750 km away' at the Kura range. Full range is commonly cited ~11,000-12,000 km; the infobox figure was not captured on fetch.
